results.name: Analysis of the recent attack activities of "Blind Eagle" forging judicial injunctions
results.description: Blind Eagle (Qianxin's internal organization number APT-Q-98) is an APT organization that Qi Anxin independently discovered and first disclosed. The Blind Eagle Organization is an APT organization suspected of originating from South America and mainly targeting Colombia. Since April 2018, the organization has targeted Colombian government agencies and large companies (financial, petroleum, manufacturing and other industries) and other important fields. Organized, planned and targeted long-term uninterrupted attacks [1] .
